content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Officers working under Central Board of Direct Taxes, Central Board of Excise and Customs, Narcotics Department, Directorate of Enforcement (Ministry of Finance) and Central Police Organisations; (a)(i) holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department OR (ii) with 3 years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on regular basis in the scale of pay Rs.5500-9000 or equivalent in the parent cadre or department. Experience required: (b) 2 years' experience in enforcement of regulatory Laws or Investigation of offences and collection of intelligence thereof. Age limit: Maximum 56 years. Pay: Pay Level - 7 (44,900 To 1,42,400) (7th CPC); Pre-revised PB-2 Rs. 9300-34800 + Grade Pay 4600. Qualification required: Officers under the Central Government Departments or organisations: Officers under Central Board of Direct Taxes, GST, Customs, Narcotics Department, Directorate of Enforcement and Central Police Organisations; (a)(i) holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) with three years' regular service in the pay scale of Rs.5500-9000 (pre revised) or equivalent; or (iii) with six years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on regular basis in the scale of pay of Rs.5000-8000 (pre revised) or equivalent. Experience required: (b) two years' experience in administration, establishment and accounts matter. Age limit: Maximum 56 years. Pay: Pay Level - 7 (44,900 To 1,42,400) (7th CPC); Pre-revised PB-2 Rs. 9300-34800 + Grade Pay 4600.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Selected official can opt for the grade pay of the post or own pay plus deputation allowance (10% of basic pay for outstation, 5% for local officials, maximum Rs.9,000/- and Rs.4,500/- respectively). Deputation governed by DOP&T O.M. No.2/29/91/Estt(PayII) dated 05.01.1994 and No.6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended Period of deputation, including preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed three years Competent Authority reserves the right to repatriate the official at any point of time before completion of deputation period

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Competent Authority SAFEM (FOP)A & NDPSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Competent Authority SAFEM (FOP)A & NDPSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Inspecting Officer Group-B (Gazetted), 1 Superintendent (Admn.) Group-B (Gazetted).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Competent Authority SAFEM (FOP)A & NDPSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I (Bio-Data / Curriculum Vitae Proforma), pages 3 to 5 of this notice) and send it to Office of the Competent Authority [SAFEM (FOP)A & NDPSA], Shastri Bhawan, New Building Complex, (4th Floor), No. 26, Haddows Road, Nungambakkam, Chennai - 600 006, by through proper channel, forwarded by the concerned office, to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Pay Level - 7 (44,900 To 1,42,400) (7th CPC); Pre-revised PB-2 Rs. 9300-34800 + Grade Pay 4600 for Inspecting Officer Group-B (Gazetted), Pay Level - 7 (44,900 To 1,42,400) (7th CPC); Pre-revised PB-2 Rs. 9300-34800 + Grade Pay 4600 for Superintendent (Admn.) Group-B (Gazetted).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Central Government officers (CBDT, CBEC/GST, Customs, Narcotics Department, Directorate of Enforcement, Central Police Organisations) holding analogous posts or with the prescribed regular service in lower pay scales, plus 2 years' relevant experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only officers of the listed Central Government departments and organisations are eligible. Application must be forwarded by the concerned office through proper channel.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications not forwarded through proper channel or not accompanied by ACRs / APARs and Vigilance Clearance will not be considered.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assessment of Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents by the Selection Committee. Information in the Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents on Essential Qualifications / Work Experience will be assessed by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation governed by DOP&T O.M. No.2/29/91/Estt(PayII) dated 05.01.1994 and No.6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended. Period of deputation, including preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed three years. Competent Authority reserves the right to repatriate the official at any point of time before completion of deputation period.
